question: पक्राउ परेको व्यक्तिलाई पक्राउ भएको कति घण्टाभित्र अदालतमा पेश गर्नुपर्छ?
response_text:
पक्राउ परेको व्यक्तिलाई न्यायिक अधिकारी समक्ष पेश गर्दा यात्राका लागि आवश्यक समयलाई बाहेक गरिन्छ [1] ।

यो कुरा पुष्टि गर्न सकिएन:
- पक्राउ परेको व्यक्तिलाई कति अधिकतम समयभित्र अदालतमा पेश गर्नुपर्छ।
- अदालतमा पेश गर्ने समय सीमा पक्राउ भएको क्षणदेखि गणना हुन्छ कि हुँदैन।
- सबै प्रकारका अपराधहरूमा (जस्तै: सामान्य र गम्भीर) एउटै समय सीमा लागू हुन्छ कि हुँदैन।

कृपया यस विषयमा थप स्पष्ट जानकारीका लागि योग्य कानूनी व्यवसायी वा अधिवक्तासँग परामर्श गर्नुहोस्।

claims.claim_question: What is the maximum number of hours within which an arrested person must be presented before a court?
Does the time limit for presenting an arrested person before a court start counting from the moment of arrest?
search_terms: when does arrest time limit begin

claims.claim_question: Is the same time limit for presenting an arrested person before a court applied to all types of offenses (e.g., misdemeanors and felonies)?
Are there any statutory exceptions (such as weekends, holidays, or emergencies) to the standard time limit for presenting an arrested person before a court?
claims.answer: The only statutory exception mentioned to the 24-hour time limit for producing an arrested person before a judicial authority is the time required for travel.
claims.evidence_span: An arrested person must be produced before the judicial authority within 24 hours of the arrest, excluding the time required for travel, and shall not be kept in custody without an order from such authority.
caveats: The evidence specifically addresses public holidays by stating that the 24-hour mandate applies even on those days, meaning holidays are not an exception.

challenge.falsification_attempt: The evidence only states that the 24‑hour production limit excludes time required for travel; it does not say that travel is the sole statutory exception. Therefore the answer overreaches by asserting that no other exceptions (e.g., weekends, holidays, emergencies) exist, which is not established by the provided source.
